mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 650K units, indicating robust demand, boosts consumer discretionary spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 650K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors seek higher yields.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) drops below 7% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by > 200K in a month, a tightening labor market drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, as firms increase investments.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when UNRATE < 7% and PAYEMS growth > 200K, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 4% YoY signals a supply-side boom, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as manufacturers expand capacity.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 45% of instances when INDPRO growth > 4% YoY, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 1.2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP (GDPC1) by > 1% QoQ indicates slowing demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days, as investors reassess growth prospects.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of instances when GDPC1 declines > 1% QoQ, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 6-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 2.5% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) growth exceeds 3% YoY, a hawkish monetary stance combats inflation, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and CPIAUCSL growth > 3% YoY, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected drop in unemployment (UNRATE) by > 0.5pp in a month, without corresponding payroll growth (PAYEMS), may indicate labor market distortions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, as investors reassess labor market health.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE drop > 0.5pp in 1 month, without PAYEMS growth
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 40% of instances when UNRATE drops > 0.5pp without PAYEMS growth, or Rank IC < 0.035 over any 1.8-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Steady RSAFS growth above 5% YoY, indicating sustained consumer spending, always supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as retailers and consumer discretionary firms benefit.
regime_hint: any regime with consumer spending growth
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 2.5-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when RSAFS growth > 5% YoY are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
